chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"If you are invited to funerals, then hasten; and if you are invited to weddings, then proceed slowly."

key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this guidance
key_terms.دُعِيتُمْ: you were invited or called to attend
key_terms.فَأَبْطِئُوا: then go slowly or without haste

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about attending funerals and weddings?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches proper social and religious etiquette in responding to different invitations. It encourages prompt attendance at funerals because of their solemn and time-sensitive nature, while advising a more unhurried approach to weddings.
